create_levy_benchmark: create a Levy benchmark function instance with a specified number of dimensions for optimization
call_levy_function: call the Levy function with a 1D numpy array input to compute the benchmark score
create_ackley_benchmark: create an Ackley benchmark function instance with a specified number of dimensions for optimization
call_ackley_function: call the Ackley function with a 1D numpy array input to compute the benchmark score
create_tracker: create a tracker instance with a folder name to log optimization results and best values
